name: Void Death
body:
School evocation [cold, darkness]; Level sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a localized void from between the stars around a target. The target is surrounded with a 5-foot-radius darkness as per the darkness spell and there is no air (or other gas or liquid) to breathe so the target must hold their breath. Additionally, the target takes 2d6 cold damage each round at the beginning of their turn. A successful Fortitude save at the beginning of their turn halves the cold damage taken that round. Creatures who do not breathe do not need to hold their breath. If a creature is killed by the cold damage, their body explodes into small chunks.

As an interesting side effect, non-magical fires in the space occupied by the target are snuffed out.
